label: organization located or based in
definition: Organization 1 is based in or has offices/sites in geographic place 2.
scope_notes: Company/firm-in, based-in and geographic noun compounds qualify. Personal residence/death, organizational employers and industry/Internet compounds are other relations. Nationality alone is ambiguous.

facts.reason: Morningstar Inc. is explicitly a publisher/company/firm in Chicago.
The Senate has leader Trent Lott; this is an organization-to-person office relation rather than a geographic location.
Compton died at his home in Elkhart, a personal residence/death relation rather than an organizational base.
Kraft General Foods is a subsidiary of Philip Morris, a corporate parent rather than a geographic location.
Mcorp is explicitly a company/group/concern in Texas.
